content.title: US Corporate Leverage Poised to Rise With  $1 Trillion Deals Deluge
content.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. this week said it’s buying coffeemaker JDE Peet’s NV and funding the deal with a €16.2 billion ($19.0 billion) bridge loan.  AT&T Inc. said on Tuesday it’s buying spectrum licenses from EchoStar Corp. for about $23 billion, a move that will probably be at least partly funded with bonds.  As the Federal Reserve started raising rates in 2022 and debt became more expensive, many companies sought to cut their borrowings.

content.title: Verint $2B deal, tariffs weigh on Wayfair, Opendoor climbs
content.description:
Here's what you need to know about three stories investors are watching from Allie Canal on Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

Verint Systems (VRNT) is set to go private with Thoma Bravo acquiring the company in a $2 billion cash deal.

Furniture stocks like Wayfair (W), RH (RH), and Lovesac (LOVE) are under pressure after President Trump warned of upcoming furniture tariffs.

Opendoor (OPEN) stock hit a fresh 52-week high on reignited rate-cut hopes.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
